Input UI components for the methylationTrack module

Source: R/methylationTrack_module_ui.R
methylationTrackInputsUI.Rd

This should be placed in the UI where the inputs should be shown, with an id that matches the id used in the methylationTrackServer() and methylationTrackOutputUI() functions.

Usage

methylationTrackInputsUI(
  id,
  data,
  defaults = NULL,
  title = "Methylation Track Settings",
  columns = 2
)

Arguments

id

The ID for the Shiny module.

data

A methylationCohort(), or anything it takes.

defaults

A named list of default values for the inputs.

title

An optional title for the UI grid.

columns

Number of columns for the UI grid.

Value

A Shiny tagList containing the UI elements

Details

The module draws methylationTrack(): a heatmap of beta values, with samples as rows and CpGs as columns, under the transcripts of a gene, region or set of probes. Its data is a methylationCohort(), or anything that takes, which can mix Infinium arrays. Arrays are joined on genomic position, and a CpG not on a sample's array has a colour of its own. The inputs are organised into tabs via VizModules::organize_inputs().

Choices in the Samples tab need no redraw to change the colours, and a change of colour scale reaches the browser as a layout-only update.

Plot parameters and defaults

The following parameters can be accessed via UI inputs and/or the defaults argument:

Data

  • locate.by - Look up a "gene", "region" or "probes" (default: "gene")

  • gene - The gene (default: none)

  • region - The region, as chr19:10260000-10380000 (default: none)

  • probes - Probe IDs, separated by commas or spaces, from one chromosome (default: none)

  • upstream, downstream - Bases added around a gene or probes (default: 2000)

  • cpg.scope - "all" CpGs on any plotted array, or those "shared" by all of them (default: "all")

  • max.cpgs - The most CpGs to draw (default: 1000)

Samples

  • filter.col, filter.levels - Keep samples with these levels of a column (default: all)

  • sample.filter - Keep samples meeting a condition, such as age > 40 (default: all)

  • group.by - Group samples on a column (default: "platform" for several arrays)

  • group.gap - Blank rows between groups (default: 1)

  • cluster.samples - Cluster samples, within any groups (default: FALSE)

  • dist.method - Distance: "euclidean", "manhattan", "pearson" or "spearman" (default: "euclidean")

  • hclust.method - Linkage, as stats::hclust() (default: "ward.D2")

  • show.dendrogram - Draw the clustering (default: TRUE)

  • anno.left, anno.right - Columns drawn as strips each side of the heatmap (default: none)

  • anno.colors - Named colours of their levels, as "column: level" (multiColorPicker; default: a colour for each level in the cohort)

  • anno.low, anno.high - Colours of a numeric strip (default: "#DEEBF7" and "#08306B")

  • show.sample.names - Label the samples (default: TRUE)

  • sample.font.size - Size of those labels (default: 10)

Tracks

  • txn.view - "full", a row per transcript, or "collapsed", a row per gene with its transcripts overlaid (default: "full")

  • txn.types - Transcript types to draw (default: "protein_coding")

  • txn.labels - Label the transcripts (default: TRUE)

  • txn.font.size - Size of those labels (default: 8)

  • exon.color, cds.color, intron.color - Transcript colours (default: "#1A1A1A", "#D7191C" and "#444444")

  • show.cytoband - Draw the ideogram (default: TRUE)

  • show.map.lines - Draw the lines from position to column (default: TRUE)

  • show.coverage - Draw which array has which CpG (default: TRUE)

  • cpg.tracks - rowData() columns drawn as strips under the heatmap (default: none)

  • cpg.labels - Label columns with "none", "probe" or "locus" (default: "none")

Aesthetics

  • The colour scale inputs of VizModules::uniform_colorscale_inputs_ui(), from 0 to 1 and titled "Beta value" by default

  • absent.color - Colour of a cell whose array lacks the CpG (default: "#BDBDBD")

  • na.color - Colour of a cell with no value on an array that has the CpG (default: "#FFFFFF")

The Legend, Axes and Plotly tabs carry the shared VizModules inputs. Only the sample and column labels follow the Axes tab, with its axis lines boxing the heatmap, and gridlines are not offered, as they would run across cells. There is no Lines tab.

See also

methylationTrack(), methylationCohort(), methylationTrackOutputUI(), methylationTrackServer(), methylationTrackApp()

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

library(sciVizModules)
data(example_methylation)
methylationTrackInputsUI("track", example_methylation)
